instructions_to_main_agent: The project uses .js/.jsx extensions. DO NOT create or use .tsx files.
Strictly follow the Bang & Olufsen museum-style aesthetic. Products must look like sculptures on a dark velvet pedestal.
Do NOT use standard white/light grey cards for products. Cards must have NO background or a very subtle #0A1526, NO borders, and NO drop shadows.
Use Framer Motion for the hero text reveal. Wrap lines in overflow-hidden divs and translate Y from 100% to 0%.
Primary background MUST be #050B14 (Deep Midnight Navy), not pure #000000. It ties into the brand's navy logo.
Use #3FB8C4 (Teal/Cyan) VERY sparingly as a laser-like accent (button borders, active states, glowing blurred blobs behind hero products).
Typography: Use Cabinet Grotesk for headings and Satoshi for body (import via Fontshare or use similar geometric/grotesque web fonts).
Ensure all images are wrapped in a div with 'overflow-hidden' so that scale-on-hover animations do not break container boundaries.
DO NOT use a complete transparent background in header or dropdowns over imagery. Use backdrop-blur-xl and semi-transparent colors (e.g., bg-[#050B14]/80).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as standard linear gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical bento grids and strong left/right typographic alignments.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft radial glows.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs and floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., 'transition: all'). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements to prevent transform conflicts.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped ghost buttons with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
